strategy.name: Aggressive (Quality) Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium swing trades in high-conviction quality large-cap stocks and liquid sector ETFs. Focuses on AI infrastructure, semiconductor leaders, and momentum names with real revenue and earnings. Trailing stops on every entry. Reigned-in profile as of June 14, 2026: 7% risk/trade, 30% max position, 60% max sector, 8 open max.
rules: Enter when 2+ triggers align: breakout, momentum leadership, oversold snapback, or near-term catalyst.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
Trim sizes ~25% in NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16–24); full size in RISK-ON (VIX <16).
20% trailing stop on every entry; tighten to 12% once +20% in profit.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; stand down for the month at −25% MTD.
Universe: liquid US large- & mid-cap stocks and broad/sector ETFs only. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no penny stocks (<$10).
